title: demo.ack (platform → server, ephemeral)
description: Proposed by Ready Up (FLEET.md §12.2). The platform's answer to demo.begin, demo.chunk and demo.end. offset = the bytes of this demo the platform has stored contiguously from 0 (after this message was applied); it only goes down after a restart request or a checksum failure. complete: true only after a demo.end whose size and sha256 matched the stored copy; the server may then delete its file. Errors: gap (a chunk started after `offset`: the server continues from offset), unknown_demo (the platform has no record of demo_id: the server sends demo.begin again), checksum (the stored copy did not match demo.end and was discarded: the server restarts from 0), storage (temporary platform failure: the server retries demo.begin with backoff), not_assigned / stale_epoch (this server never held that match / epoch) and too_large (over max_demo_size): the server stops streaming this demo and keeps its file.
